messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw steady memory growth + an increasing 'stale_block_count' during a long-context regen run (~50k tokens). Repro attached below. Logs show alignment deltas on blocks that should have been evicted.

maria: Repro steps:
```
# run locally
./tools/run_infer --model small-v2 --context-length 50000 --batch-size 1 --seed 42 --profile-kv
# wait ~3000 tokens into the stream
```
Logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-18 10:12:34] INFO  kvcache: allocate page id=42 token_start=12345 token_end=12500 owner=req-9
[2026-03-18 10:12:34] WARN  kvcache: stale_block detected id=42 last_seq=9876 current_seq=9879 alignment_delta=3
stale_block_count=17 memory_rss=1123MB
```

liam: Any recent changes to eviction order / batching heuristics? This smells like cross-request tag reuse or a stale tag after page-compact.

maria: Bisected to commit abcdef1 (2026-03-10) — change was in batch-split -> eviction ordering to prefer contiguous pages. Before that, compaction ran with strict per-request tombstones.

kevin: perf-bot is also flagging regression on nightly long-context suite.

perf-bot: nightly/long_context_mem: baseline=1000MB current=1120MB (+12%), test=long_context_regen, job=ci/perf-nightly-02. Regression detected at 2026-03-18 03:00:00 UTC.

liam: Could be that the new ordering allows a block to be retained with an old request_id tag that later gets reused for a different request, causing misaligned token starts. Check request_id stamping and TTL.

maria: I dumped a few nearby KV entries when repro hit. Example dump:
```
page=42 slot=7 key_tag=0x3a request_id=req-9 token_start=12345
page=42 slot=8 key_tag=0x39 request_id=req-4 token_start=12200
```
The tag on slot=7 didn't get refreshed on reuse (expected increment). alignment_delta above (3) corresponds to token_start mismatch vs cache index.

kevin: If tags are not refreshed atomically with the page swap, we can get stale reads. Could also be a race between compaction and batch-split kernel selection that moves pages between slab lists.

liam: I'll add a dev-assert that fails if a reused slot has request_id older than the current global seq for the owner. Also adding an invariant check around tag refresh in compact().

maria: Creating a minimal unit test and smoke reproducer. Will open PR with bisect notes + failing test: #4382. Put labels: kvcache, regression, high-priority.

deploy-bot: Staging cluster snapshot scheduled for 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC. Will run long-context smoke after deploy.

kevin: Thanks — once the assert is in, we can reproduce in CI and then try reverting the eviction-order change if needed. Plan to triage first thing tomorrow in eng-runtime sync.

maria: FYI adding a quick workaround in serving runtime: force per-request tombstone on compaction path (cheap opt) until we have proper tag-refresh atomicity. Will post PR link when ready. :pray:
